Files ticket 0002: DOIfetch should consult the user's Zotero library before fetching, to avoid re-downloading papers already held.

## Why
Today the only dedup is a filesystem check in each fetcher: a filename built from the paper **title** in `PAPERS_DIR`. So a paper already in Zotero (but not in `PAPERS_DIR`) is refetched, and the check keys on cleaned title rather than DOI, defeating dedup on any title mismatch.

## Scope of this PR
Ticket only — no code change. The ticket is a handoff document specifying an opt-in, DOI-keyed Zotero SQLite lookup that short-circuits `_fetch_one` to `"skipped"` before any source runs, preserving current behavior when disabled.

Ticket-ref: tickets/0002-check-zotero-library-before-fetching-to.erg

commits.messageBody:
DOIfetch currently dedups only against its own PAPERS_DIR by cleaned
title; papers already in the user's Zotero library are refetched. This
ticket specifies an opt-in Zotero-first lookup (SQLite, DOI-keyed) that
short-circuits to "skipped" before any source runs, for robust use
against an existing reference library.

Ticket: none

commits.messageBody:
Per author: the Zotero-first dedup should be ON by default whenever a
Zotero DB can be located (standard locations + ZOTERO_DB_PATH override),
not opt-in. Add --no-check-zotero to force off; no-DB and broken/locked
DB both degrade silently to current behavior.

Ticket: none
